# Structured data generated by the site

The static build inserts Schema.org JSON-LD into the generated pages. Values
are produced with `json.dumps(..., ensure_ascii=False)` and always use absolute
canonical URLs. Do not edit generated HTML under `public/`; update the content
JSON files and rebuild instead.

## Homepage

The homepage contains an `@graph` with:

- `WebSite`;
- `WebPage`;
- `RadioSeries` for **sounds of electronic art**.

The series uses the programme description, Radio Blau as production company,
the public SoundCloud and Instagram profiles, and the three team members from
`content/site.json`.

## Broadcast pages

Generated pages below `/sendungen/` contain:

- `RadioEpisode`;
- a reference to the homepage `RadioSeries`;
- `AudioObject` when an `audio_url` exists.

For SoundCloud recordings the audio object uses the public track page as `url`
and the SoundCloud widget address as `embedUrl`. A valid ISO-8601 `duration` is
added when `duration_ms` is present in the archive cache or a matching duration
is available in `content/site.json`.

Upcoming radio broadcasts below `/termine/` use `RadioEpisode` together with a
`BroadcastEvent` containing the local start/end times and Radio Blau as the
`RadioBroadcastService`.

## Public event pages

An Upcoming item with:

```json
"type": "event"
```

receives `MusicEvent` JSON-LD. The following visible fields are used when
available:

```json
{
  "date": "2026-09-12T20:00:00+02:00",
  "end": "2026-09-13T02:00:00+02:00",
  "type": "event",
  "title_de": "sofea night",
  "summary_de": "Eine Nacht mit dem sofea-Team und Gästen.",
  "venue_name": "Conne Island",
  "location_de": "Conne Island, Leipzig",
  "street_address": "Koburger Straße 3",
  "postal_code": "04277",
  "address_locality": "Leipzig",
  "address_region": "Sachsen",
  "address_country": "DE",
  "image": "assets/images/sofea-night.jpg",
  "lineup": [
    {
      "name": "96kbps",
      "url": "https://soundcloud.com/skile",
      "schema_type": "Person"
    }
  ]
}
```

`schema_type` is optional. It defaults to `PerformingGroup`; use a valid
Schema.org type such as `Person`, `MusicGroup` or `PerformingGroup` when you
know the appropriate type.

No address, performer, image or external URL is invented. Empty optional
properties are omitted. The description, title, date and venue must match the
visible page content.

## Validation

The repository validator parses every generated JSON-LD block and fails the
build if the JSON is invalid or the Schema.org context is missing:

```bash
python scripts/build.py
python scripts/validate_site.py public
```

After deployment, additionally test representative pages with:

- Google Rich Results Test for supported Google features such as events;
- Schema.org Validator for the full RadioSeries, RadioEpisode and AudioObject
  vocabulary;
- Google Search Console URL Inspection after the page is indexed.

Correct structured data can help search engines understand a page, but does
not guarantee a particular search-result presentation.
